generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tenderer should be class 1 Electrical contractor. As a proof of this, a copy of the valid Electrical License issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be furnished

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

Intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar work such as experience in executing 6.6KV HT Motor works like Overhauling/ Breakdown Periodical maintenance in 210MW and above thermal plant worth not less than Rs.1.10 lakhs in the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) As a proof of the bidder shall upload work order and relevant work done certificate issued by an officer of the rank of Chief engineer/competent authority

Intending bidder should have achieved and annual average financial turnover of Rs-4.40. Lakhs in at least two of the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload copies of turnover certificate or profit and losses statement duly certificate by charted accountant (Financial turnover for Previous years shall be given weightage 10 per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenderer are invited.
